name: Undercover
description: Civilian or spy? Use words to hide and reveal — find the odd one out.
rules: Each player gets a word: civilians share word A, undercovers share word B (related but different). Take turns giving a one-word clue. Vote to eliminate someone each round. Eliminate all undercovers to win as civilian; if undercovers equal or outnumber civilians, undercovers win.
describeHint: Describe your word (don't say it directly)
describeInstructions: Describe your word in up to 50 characters
waitingForVotes: Waiting for other players to vote...
tieRound: Tie vote! Only tied players re-describe

log.civilianWins: Civilians eliminated all undercovers — civilians win!
